WITH equip_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    TRIM(equipref) as equipref,
    AVG(humepct) as avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY TRIM(equipref)
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(humepct) as overall_avg
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
),
above_avg_equip AS (
  SELECT 
    e.equipref,
    e.avg_humidity,
    o.overall_avg
  FROM equip_avg e
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
  WHERE e.avg_humidity > o.overall_avg
),
group_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) as gm
  FROM above_avg_equip
)
SELECT 
  a.equipref,
  ROUND(a.avg_humidity, 2) as avg_humidity,
  ROUND(a.avg_humidity - a.overall_avg, 2) as exceeds_overall,
  ROUND(a.avg_humidity - g.gm, 2) as exceeds_group
FROM above_avg_equip a
CROSS JOIN group_mean g
WHERE a.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND g.gm IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY exceeds_group DESC, a.equipref
LIMIT 10
